decks.notes: This deck revolves around deploying a fast and relentless army of goblin creatures to overwhelm the opponent quickly. Using cards like Goblin Lackey to cheat out creatures early, combined with powerful tribal buffs like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver, allows for explosive starts. Removal and reach are provided by cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator, while utility cards like Goblin Matron allow for tutoring key pieces. The main game plan is to flood the board with goblins, applying pressure and finishing off the opponent with a combination of efficient creatures and burn spells.

The deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with efficient, aggressive creatures and burn spells. By keeping the pressure on the opponent and dealing direct damage with cards like Lightning Bolt and Fireblast, it aims to finish the game as quickly as possible. The inclusion of creatures like Mogg Fanatic and Jackal Pup allows for early aggression, while cards like Sulfuric Vortex and Price of Progress put additional pressure on the opponent. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and punishing, emphasizing swift wins over prolonged battles.

The deck focuses on using Tinker to search for and sacrifice Phyrexian Devourer to bring out a game-winning combo with Fling. By combining Altar of Dementia for self-mill and Defense Grid for protection, the deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for a lethal Fling. Tsabo's Web helps control opponent's land while Impulse, Intuition, and Chromatic Sphere provide card selection and mana fixing. The deck's mana base allows for fast and consistent plays to set up the combo win condition.

The key concept of this deck is to quickly swarm the board with small, efficient white creatures to overwhelm the opponent and finish the game quickly. This Aggro - White Weenie deck focuses on aggressive early game plays with strong removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and disenchant effects to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck also includes protective creatures like Mother of Runes and True Believer to ensure the survival of the key creatures like Exalted Angel and Paladin en-Vec. This deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent to victory.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly disrupt the opponent's hand and board state, while applying consistent pressure with aggressive creatures. By combining discard spells like Duress, Unburden, and Stupor with efficient removal like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, the deck aims to control the game early on. The creatures in the deck, such as Ravenous Rats, Lavaborn Muse, and Rotting Giant, provide a clock to close out the game. Mishra's Factory can also serve as a resilient threat. Overall, the deck seeks to punish opponents with a combination of disruption and aggression.

The deck revolves around using the combo of Phyrexian Dreadnought and Stifle to quickly and efficiently win the game. By utilizing countermagic and card selection spells like Counterspell, Daze, and Gush, the deck aims to protect and assemble the combo as fast as possible. Additionally, cards like Portent and Opt provide card advantage and help dig for the needed pieces. Mishra's Factory serves as a versatile attacker and blocker, adding flexibility to the deck's game plan.

This deck focuses on utilizing artifact mana acceleration and disruption cards to quickly assemble a powerful combo involving Altar of Dementia and either Phyrexian Devourer or Karn, Silver Golem. By generating large amounts of mana and disrupting the opponent's resources with Tangle Wire and Winter Orb, the deck aims to set up the combo as quickly as possible to achieve victory. The inclusion of cards like Meditate and Tinker helps to find the necessary pieces to complete the combo efficiently.

The deck focuses on assembling the Tinker combo to quickly find and play powerful artifacts, such as Altar of Dementia or Phyrexian Devourer, and then using Fling to deal a massive amount of damage to the opponent in one shot. It also includes disruption elements like Defense Grid and Tangle Wire to control the game while setting up the combo. The mana base is designed to provide fast and efficient mana production to support the quick execution of the combo.

The focus of this mono black aggro deck is to quickly bring out aggressive creatures and disrupt the opponent's strategy with hand disruption spells. The deck utilizes cards like Dark Ritual to power out creatures ahead of schedule, while also utilizing cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress to strip the opponent's hand of key cards. The deck also includes creature removal and card draw in the form of Snuff Out, Skeletal Scrying, and Cursed Scroll. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast and disruptive aggro strategy.

This deck focuses on deploying aggressive creatures like Exalted Angel, Hypnotic Specter, and Nantuko Shade to quickly overwhelm opponents. By utilizing cards like Dark Ritual and Swords to Plowshares to gain a tempo advantage, along with disruption tools like Duress and Gerrard's Verdict, it aims to disrupt opponent's strategy while maintaining a steady stream of card advantage with Phyrexian Arena. The deck also includes removal spells like Vindicate and Disenchant to deal with threats, and mana denial with Wasteland to slow down opponents.

The main idea of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a fast-paced and aggressive strategy using Goblin creatures. By utilizing cards like Goblin Lackey and Goblin Matron to quickly get powerful creatures onto the battlefield, combined with cards like Goblin Warchief and Goblin Piledriver to boost their effectiveness, this deck aims to deal damage quickly and efficiently. Additionally, cards like Siege-Gang Commander and Gempalm Incinerator provide additional removal and reach, while cards like Rishadan Port and Wasteland disrupt the opponent's resources. The deck's mana base is also built to support this aggressive strategy.

The deck focuses on utilizing various control elements such as Winter Orb and Tangle Wire to disrupt opponent's game plan while utilizing Survival of the Fittest to search for key creatures like Deranged Hermit and Tradewind Rider. The deck aims to maintain board control and outvalue the opponent through card advantage and efficient creature interactions. The inclusion of creatures with disruptive abilities like Rishadan Cutpurse and Nantuko Vigilante further adds to the deck's control strategy, allowing for a versatile and adaptable gameplay approach.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly and aggressively deal damage to the opponent using low-cost creatures and burn spells. By consistently applying pressure early in the game with cards like Grim Lavamancer, Mogg Fanatic, and Jackal Pup, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to stabilize. The inclusion of cards like Ball Lightning and Sulfuric Vortex ensures that the pressure continues even as the game progresses, making it difficult for the opponent to recover. Overall, the deck focuses on a fast, relentless offense to secure victory.

The primary focus of this mono black control deck is to disrupt and dismantle the opponent's hand and resources while utilizing discard spells like Duress, Cabal Therapy, and Unmask. The deck also applies continuous pressure using cards like Hypnotic Specter and The Rack to deplete the opponent's resources and life total. With the addition of removal spells like Smother and Diabolic Edict, as well as card advantage engines like Cursed Scroll and Guiltfeeder, the deck aims to maintain control of the game until victory is achieved.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by consistently disrupting the opponent's strategy while deploying strong threats like Blastoderm, Ravenous Baloth, and Spiritmonger. The deck utilizes cards like Wall of Blossoms and Wall of Roots to help stabilize and ramp into bigger threats. Removal spells like Smother and Vendetta help to deal with opposing threats, while cards like Cabal Therapy and Duress help to disrupt the opponent's hand. Pernicious Deed is a powerful board wipe option, and Recurring Nightmare provides additional value by recurring creatures from the graveyard. The deck also has a toolbox element with Living Wish to search for specific answers or threats.

The main focus of this White Weenie Aggro deck is to overwhelm the opponent with cheap and efficient creatures like Deftblade Elite, Savannah Lions, Silver Knight, and more. The deck also includes removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Disenchant to deal with threats, as well as cards like Cursed Scroll and Enlightened Tutor for extra utility. The goal is to quickly establish a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent while also having answers to their threats. The inclusion of Wasteland helps to disrupt the opponent's mana base and gain an advantage.
